source.name: robo_4_astra.stl
source.provenance: User supplied CAD export; shell/head extracted by original part colors, removable cover isolated as the rearmost connected component of its material. Internal electronics omitted. Body/cover coordinates are snapped to a 0.001 mm grid (at most 0.0005 mm per coordinate) to remove sub-micron CAD export discrepancies along their shared rim. The complete existing side panel and mating rim (x=-39..-32.5 mm) are copied and reflected across x=0. All original opposing geometry at x>32.5 mm is removed before the mirrored copy is joined. This makes both complete side assemblies symmetric, without overlapping patches. Central camera/speaker apertures are retained. Solid Boolean assembly removes internal contact faces.

sidePanels.method: Remove target band, then union one reflected copy of the complete source panel and mating rim.

screen.description: Default PlaneGeometry +Z normal; recessed inside actual CAD bezel. Width 34 and height 29.142857 preserve the 280x240 image aspect while fitting the measured aperture without clipping. Suggested dark backing 35x31 at this depth.

wheels.description: Original approximate display wheels: radius 25 mm, centers x=+/-43 mm, width 9 mm, hub radius 21.8 mm. Keep the CAD shell at its original height and wheels directly beside its panels, without axle extensions. The illustration is intentionally approximate; movement calculations use the separate physics values, not these display dimensions.

camera.description: Suggested procedural lens centered in the existing shell cutout; dimensions estimated from CAD front projection.

speaker.description: Place dark backing behind existing speaker cutouts.

physics.description: Movement calculations use 12 cm per wheel rotation, 9 cm between wheel centers, and 30 motor rotations per wheel rotation. The track is updated to the tutor's requested 9 cm; the approximate display geometry is independent.
